gaps.reason: the source marks this suspected-diagnosis/problem value set not implemented with no codes; VHF-R2 retains the implemented SNOMED diagnosis and active-problem branches

gaps.valueSet: Rule 3 Viral Hemorrhagic Fever culture-test orders
gaps.reason: the source marks both the organism-specific culture-test and culture-panel value sets not implemented with no codes, so the wholly inoperable rule is omitted
SEM_V1 laboratory evidence does not distinguish an order from a completed observation; coded test and panel OIDs are modeled with labTestInValueSet
the source marks the Viral Hemorrhagic Fever antigen and antibody panel value sets not implemented with no LOINC codes; their coded individual-test alternatives remain modeled

gaps.valueSet: Rule 7 clinical findings plus epidemiologic exposure
gaps.reason: all six required epidemiologic exposure criteria are explicitly not implemented, and SEM_V1 has no epidemiologic exposure evidence; the wholly inoperable rule is omitted (SEM_V1 also cannot evaluate its numeric body-temperature threshold)

gaps.valueSet: Rule 8 organism-specific Viral Hemorrhagic Fever culture test
gaps.reason: the source marks the required organism-specific culture-test value set not implemented with no LOINC codes; VHF-R8 retains both implemented generic-test alternatives with same-observation VHF-virus results
SEM_V1 has no numeric laboratory result value or comparison predicate; the numeric alternative is omitted
the source identifies death-certificate Viral Hemorrhagic Fever evidence, but SEM_V1 has no death-certificate evidence
